contact.faq0q: How long does a Caste Certificate take?
contact.faq0a: Caste Certificates are typically processed within 24–48 hours of submission. You will receive an SMS and in-app notification once approved.
contact.faq1q: What documents are required for a Pension application?
contact.faq1a: You will need: Aadhaar card, age proof (birth certificate or school leaving certificate), bank passbook (first page), income certificate, and a passport-sized photograph. Documents can be uploaded digitally during the application.
contact.faq2q: Can I apply for multiple services simultaneously?
contact.faq2a: Yes. Each service application is tracked independently with its own application number. You can submit multiple applications at the same time and track each one separately from your dashboard.
contact.faq3q: How do I update my family member details?
contact.faq3a: Go to My Family in the navigation menu. From there you can view all registered family members and submit a change request. Changes are verified by the Village Revenue Officer (VRO) office within 3–5 working days.
contact.faq4q: What if my application is rejected?
contact.faq4a: You have the right to appeal within 30 days of rejection. Go to My Applications, open the rejected application, and click "Raise Grievance". The grievance will be reviewed by a senior officer.
contact.faq5q: Is my data safe on Citizen Services?

uc4.wordingSelf: The Education department wants to check if you can get a scholarship. It will ask: is your family income below a limit, which category you belong to, where you live, and your age. It gets a yes or no. It does not get your certificates. This permission lasts until {{date}} and you can stop it any time.

It will ask: is the family income below a limit, which category {{student}} belongs to, where {{student}} lives, and {{student}}'s age. It gets a yes or no. It does not get certificates. This permission lasts until {{date}} and you can stop it any time.

uc5.title: Housing assistance check
uc5.wordingSelf: The Housing department wants to check whether your household can get housing assistance. It looks at the whole household, but only you answer. It will ask: is your household income below a limit, where the household lives, whether anyone in it already gets housing assistance, whether there is an electricity connection, and whether the household holds land. It gets a yes or no. It does not get an income figure, anyone's certificates, or another member's personal details, and other members are not asked. This permission lasts until {{date}} (90 days) and you can refuse or stop it any time.
uc5.wordingParent: The Housing department wants to check whether the household can get housing assistance. Only the adult applicant answers; other members are not asked. This permission lasts until {{date}}.
